name: USAFA
description: Undergraduate institution training future Air Force and Space Force officers; also hosts 10th Air Base Wing.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. Trusted Traveler Program suspended — 100% ID checks at all gates. All visitors without a DoD ID must obtain a sponsored pass at the Pass & Registration Office.

gates.name: South Gate (Visitors / Non-DoD)
gates.notes: Primary gate for visitors and non-DoD personnel. Access via I-25 Exit 150. Pass & Registration Office located outside South Gate on the right side of the road. Trusted Traveler suspended — 100% ID checks.
gates.address: I-25 Exit 150, South Gate Blvd, USAF Academy, CO 80840

gates.name: North Gate (DoD ID Encouraged)
gates.notes: DoD ID cardholders encouraged. Access via I-25 Exit 156. Sponsored visitors may also use this gate during posted hours. 100% ID checks in effect.
gates.address: I-25 Exit 156, North Gate Blvd, USAF Academy, CO 80840

gates.name: Pass & Registration Office (South Gate)
gates.notes: Located outside South Gate via I-25 Exit 150. Weekends reserved for events, cadet visitors, and housing guests only. Closed for training on the third Tuesday of each month. Plan 1–2 hour wait times during peak periods. REAL ID required.
gates.address: Outside South Gate, I-25 Exit 150, USAF Academy, CO 80840

gates.name: USAFA Visitor Center
gates.notes: Visitor information, cadet area tours, and base access guidance. All visitors without DoD ID require a sponsored pass — Trusted Traveler suspended.

resources.name: Polaris Perk
resources.description: Starbucks coffee shop in Arnold Hall with breakfast, lunch, and snack menu. Frequent drink card — buy 10 drinks, get the 11th free. No traditional large public DFAC on base; Polaris Perk is a primary café option.
resources.address: Arnold Hall, 2302 Cadet Dr, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: Arnold Hall Dining
resources.description: Cadet and community dining hub in Arnold Hall featuring Richter Lounge Food Court (Domino's, Subway, Mediterranean grill), Polaris Perk café, and Hap's Place cadet lounge.
resources.address: 2302 Cadet Dr, Arnold Hall, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: High Country Inn Dining
resources.description: Enlisted dining facility with south-facing Front Range views and large patio overlooking Pine Valley. Authorized for ESM, Prep School, BAS, officers, retirees, and DoD civilians per AFI 34-240.
resources.hours: See usafasupport.com for weekly menus and meal times
resources.address: High Country Inn, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: Falcon Club
resources.description: Premier catering and event venue with scenic Cadet Area and Front Range views. Private lunches for groups of 25+, reunions, retirement parties, wedding receptions, and The Pub. Seating for up to 500 guests.
resources.hours: Reservations required NLT 2 business days prior; call for Pub hours
resources.address: Adjacent to Rampart Lodge, near Doolittle Hall, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: USAFA Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency grocery with bakery, deli, fresh sandwiches, rotisserie chicken, sushi, party cakes, and CLICK2GO curbside pickup. Closed Mondays.
resources.hours: Tue-Fri 0900-1900 (Early Bird 0800-0900); Sat 0800-1900; Sun 1000-1800; Mon closed
resources.address: 5126 Community Center Dr, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: USAFA Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Main Exchange with clothing, electronics, food court, barber shop, optical, and retail services for the USAFA community.
resources.address: 5124 Community Center Dr, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: BX Shoppette / Gas Station
resources.description: Convenience store and gas station on the BX complex.
resources.address: Community Center Dr, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: 10th Medical Group
resources.description: Ambulatory MTF serving USAFA — primary care, specialty clinics, behavioral health, dental, optometry, lab, and immunizations. Cadet Clinic and beneficiary appointments available.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri Mon-Fri 0730-1630; call for appointment availability

resources.name: Base Fitness Center
resources.description: State-of-the-art cardio, strength, and free-weight equipment, group exercise classes, intramural sports, racquetball, basketball gyms, and indoor pool. Free equipment orientation available. Satellite Fitness Center open 24/7 for CAC holders on west side of South Gate bridge.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2200; Sat-Sun 0600-1930; pool hours vary — family swim Sat-Sun 1230-1530

resources.name: Air Academy Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union with deposit accounts, loans, mortgages, and ATMs at BX, Fairchild Hall, and Arnold Hall.
resources.address: 5136 Community Center Dr, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service for 10 ABW personnel.

resources.name: Eisenhower Golf Club
resources.description: Two 18-hole championship courses — the Blue and the Silver — with PGA instruction, clinics, junior golf program, and catering. Home course of the Air Force Academy intercollegiate golf team.
resources.hours: See usafasupport.com for tee times and seasonal hours

resources.name: Academy Lanes
resources.description: Bowling center with AMF Edge String pinsetters, Neoverse LED system, and Ten Pin Grill snack bar.

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rentals (campers, grills, bounce houses, backpacking gear, watercraft), ski/snowboard shop, bike shop, fishing licenses, and adventure programs. Located in the Community Center.

resources.name: Information, Tickets & Travel (ITT)
resources.description: Discounted tickets for local attractions (Royal Gorge Train, Denver Aquarium, Olympic Museum), sports events, Disney/Universal resorts, ski passes, and lodging bookings anywhere in the US.

resources.name: Equestrian Center
resources.description: 44,000 acres of riding terrain with guided trail rides, lessons, summer camps, hayrides, boarding, and trailer-ins. South of Pine Valley housing, west of Air Academy High School.
resources.hours: See usafasupport.com for ride schedules and seasonal hours
resources.address: South of Pine Valley Housing, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: Rampart Lodge (AF Inn)
resources.description: Air Force Inns with 77 guest rooms and 20 TLF extended-stay units. Free high-speed internet, cardio fitness room, and complimentary breakfast 0600-0900 for lodging guests. Adjacent to Falcon Club.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; Check-in 1400, Check-out 1100

resources.name: Housing Management Office
resources.description: On-base cadet housing and family housing managed by Balfour Beatty Communities. Required visit before signing any off-base lease.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions. Located in the Community Center. Appointment-based via RAPIDS.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, deployment support, financial readiness, TAP workshops, spouse employment, EFMP, and newcomers orientation. Appointments preferred.
resources.address: 6248 W Pine Loop, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: 10th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — dining, fitness, recreation, lodging, community events, and family programs for the Long Blue Line.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website

resources.name: Pass & Registration Office
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access for all personnel without DoD ID. Trusted Traveler suspended — sponsored passes required. REAL ID required for entry.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1500; weekends for events, cadet visitors, and housing guests only
resources.address: Outside South Gate, I-25 Exit 150, USAF Academy, CO 80840

resources.name: Security Forces Squadron
resources.description: Base defense, law enforcement, and gate operations. 100% ID checks at all gates.

events.title: Newcomers Briefing
events.address: 6248 W Pine Loop, USAF Academy, CO 80840
events.description: Orientation for incoming 10 ABW personnel and families. Bring PCS orders and ID cards.

events.title: Red, White & Brews
events.description: Patriotic community social at the Falcon Club with food and beverages.

events.title: Summer Reading Program
events.description: Base library summer reading program for families and youth.

primaryAction.title: USAFA Pass & Registration Office
primaryAction.address: Outside South Gate, I-25 Exit 150, USAF Academy, CO 80840

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement. REAL ID required for base access.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Attend the newcomers briefing at the M&FRC. All visitors and personnel without DoD ID must process through Pass & Registration at the South Gate.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. On-base family housing is managed by Balfour Beatty Communities; cadet housing is on-base. Rampart Lodge offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: South Gate (I-25 Exit 150) is open 24/7 for visitors and non-DoD personnel. North Gate (I-25 Exit 156) is open daily 0500-2200 — DoD ID encouraged. Pass & Registration Office is Mon-Fri 0730-1500 outside South Gate. Trusted Traveler suspended — 100% ID checks at all gates.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus 10th FSS MWR programs and Military OneSource for relocation support.
